name: Como
oneLiner: Loyalty, CRM and guest engagement platform (Como Sense) for restaurant and retail chains, owned by Global Payments since 2023.
bestFor: Multi-unit restaurant and QSR chains, especially those on POS systems Como integrates with, that want a branded loyalty program, guest profiles and automated marketing in one tool.

updates.text: Quantic POS announced an integration with Como Sense.
Release added AI-generated campaign summaries (beta, UK, US and Australia) and a redesigned member import tool.

features: Unified guest profiles that link POS purchases to individual members
Configurable loyalty programs: points, rewards and member benefits
Branded mobile app and digital membership
Segmentation and automated marketing campaigns across email, SMS and app
Program and campaign analytics, with AI campaign summaries in beta
Member import tools for brands moving from an older club or list
Wide POS integration network (Revel, Oracle MICROS, PAR, Quantic and others)
Entry-level POS-integrated version (Como Sense Express) for smaller operators

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Como does not publish prices.

notes: Como was acquired by Global Payments in 2023 (April 2023 per startupim.com) and now trades as 'Como, a Global Payments company' (https://www.restaurantonline.co.uk/Suppliers/como-a-global-payments-company/); the product is still sold. Both 2026 updates come from a third-party company profile (yespress.io, updated Oct 2026), not a Como press release; verify on como.com if possible. Customer announcements are older: Creams Cafe 2017, Rush Bowls Nov 2023 (47 US locations), Villa Italian Kitchen rollout to 200+ US locations (date not confirmed). Older 2017 release also named Burger King and Quiznos; left out as dated. No 2025 or 2026 restaurant customer announcement found. Dropped: RevoltTek's 'up to 34% higher retention' claim and a Tarka testimonial (40,000 members) that could not be tied to a Como source. Current review's 'CDP' framing is fair as guest profiles + loyalty, but Como is primarily a loyalty/CRM product.
